Industry / Packaging and labels

Selection barriers

Why AI mixes packaging producers with different capabilities

A folding carton, a food-contact container and a printed label are different procurement problems.

01

Material suitability is not demonstrated

Food contact, barrier properties, storage temperature and compatibility with the packed product must be evidenced for the specific packaging material and design.

02

Run size and pricing are unclear

Print setup, tooling, die cutting, quantities and samples affect costs. A headline unit price should not be generalized across technologies.

03

Compliance is applied to unrelated items

TR CU 005/2011 applies to packaging and closures within its stated scope. A stand-alone label is not automatically covered in the same way as a food container.

Different product applications and run sizes require different manufacturer evidence.

Verifiable facts

Evidence for packaging suitability

TR CU 005/2011 establishes safety requirements for packaging and closures within its stated scope. Assessment depends on the actual material, intended use and product classification. This does not certify every item produced or every label design.

  • Materials and function: construction, dimensions, contact suitability where relevant, barrier properties and closure design
  • Production: proof samples, tooling, print specification, minimum quantity, tolerances and lead-time conditions
  • Documentation: applicable conformity procedures, test results where required, and accurate technical marking

GAEO's industrial GEO methodology is not presented as an existing measured result for a packaging producer.

Scope of work

How I structure a packaging manufacturer's GEO programme

The programme follows sourcing questions about use cases, production capabilities and quantities.

  1. 01

    Segment the buying tasks

    Separate food and cosmetics packaging, transport containers, printed labels, custom production and territories.

  2. 02

    Verify manufacturing claims

    Review specifications, samples, lead-time constraints, minimum runs, supporting tests and evidence.

  3. 03

    Build useful product references

    Plan technology pages, specific applications, permission-cleared project examples and FAQs about quantities and samples.

  4. 04

    Repeat AI visibility checks

    Measure BMR on comparable prompts and check whether assistants accurately describe materials, lead times and available products.

FAQ

Questions about the service

Can custom packaging GEO work without fixed online prices?+

Yes. Document material options, manufacturing limits, quotation requirements and realistic minimum quantities without inventing a unit price.

Does packaging regulation automatically cover every label?+

No. Applicability depends on classification and intended use. A stand-alone printed label must not automatically inherit a food container's compliance status.

Can we show another company's branded packaging in our portfolio?+

Only with appropriate permission and an accurate description of the work actually completed. A sample must not be called a mass-production contract.

Does Product/Offer markup guarantee AI recommendations?+

No. It can help supported search product scenarios but does not control ChatGPT or other AI responses.

How much does GEO for packaging suppliers cost?+

GAEO's published plans apply; scope depends on manufacturing methods, product types, target sectors and baseline questions.
